steps.name: Check immediate draw feedback and recovery

checks: Map cards replace select; host choice persists and reaches guest; guest cannot change it
Arrow/Home keyboard navigation and reconnect preserve authoritative choice
Compact preview opens all six variants; Escape disposes canvas and restores focus
Laptop/mobile fit, sticky start, scrolling maps and all six gallery models on mobile
Map titles, badges and controls translate into English
Selected South America starts for both clients; lobby preview resources are released
Blind double click: immediate backs, bounded queue, two durable draws, no duplicate flights/sounds or rival disclosure
Two visible equal-color cards retain their distinct original slots
Depleted deck rebases the queued card after the first slot is removed
Three locomotives renew the market and cancel the old queued choice
Stale action rejects both provisional cards, restores controls and never executes the queued choice
Disconnect after send: one persisted draw, same-ID retry, canceled queue and no replayed animation
390px mobile and reduced motion preserve pending/confirmed semantics without overflow
Resize cancels provisional geometry and unsent choice without replaying the confirmed flight
Server without feedback capability keeps the legacy single confirmed animation
Failed remote commit removes previews, rolls back hand and keeps play paused
